lede: Every Lovable plan, what each credit tier costs, and the cheapest way to get the credits you need.
calc_label: Lovable credits you need each month
calc_note: The calculator uses Pro plan credit tiers, on monthly or yearly billing. The Free plan is left out because Lovable does not publish its free credit amount. Lovable says credits roll over and you can top up on demand.
after_plans: Prices above are for 100 monthly credits. On yearly billing, which Lovable describes as 2 months free, Pro tiers cost $21 to $1,875 a month and Business $42 a month for 100 credits. The tier table shows monthly billing. Enterprise has a platform fee with volume pricing, by quote.

compare.Free plan: Yes, with free credit grants and unlimited collaborators
compare.Most credits on a public plan: Pro: 10,000 credits for $2,250/month, or $1,875/month billed yearly
compare.Yearly billing: Described by Lovable as 2 months free

faq: Lovable has a free plan. Pro starts at $25/month for 100 credits ($21/month billed yearly), and Business at $50/month ($42/month billed yearly). Pro can go up to 10,000 credits for $2,250/month.
Yes. The Free plan includes free credit grants, unlimited collaborators and 5 lovable.app domains, with invite-only publishing.
Lovable lists credit rollovers and on-demand credit top-ups as Pro plan features.
Both start with 100 monthly credits. Business costs more because it adds a team workspace, role-based access, SSO and priority support.
